mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 3.0% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that may prompt central bank intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand slowdown, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 210), a federal funds rate above 2.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 210 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 137,000, it signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 137000.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) level, which reflects a stronger manufacturing sector, is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 137000), strong employment conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 137000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1050, it signals a weakening housing market, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1050.
